_note: v2.9 03 S0 (no-model lane): the debug stand-in polish (fixed find/replace after a delay, no model call) writes a received reply before fireAfterSpeak and the boundary; the boundary consumes the polished text (no eventless-change journal, no rollback); a quiet GENERATION_STARTED during the hold abandons the next candidate and leaves the reply as sent. Scripted /sendas rows are admitted only through the stand-in's includeScripted flag, because a no-model lane has no generated replies. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v29-03-polish-standin.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The keeper smirks and bolts the door.
